children: Afya’s Q3 2026 revenue rose 6.1% year over year to R$985.2M and Adjusted EBITDA increased 8.7% to R$433.8M. The company reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance; it also reported nine-month net income of R$634.0M, up 6.9%.
Growth signals continued expansion, though the release provides no analyst consensus for comparison.
Q3 Adjusted EBITDA R$433.8M, up 8.7% YoY
EBITDA grew faster than revenue; the 44.0% margin increased 100 basis points year over year.
Nine-month net income R$634.0M, up 6.9% YoY
Profit growth continued, with the company citing an OECD Pillar Two tax impact in Brazil.
No guidance figures are included in the release text, limiting comparison with prior targets.
Net debt fell R$169.7M since Dec. 31, 2025
Debt declined despite R$459.3M returned through dividends and repurchases during the nine months.

This is a mid-cycle quarterly update, with revenue and EBITDA growth alongside the previously announced proposed merger with Yduqs. The next catalysts are shareholder and regulatory decisions on the merger and delivery of the reaffirmed 2026 guidance.
